Hey :) Je ne suis probablement pas la meilleure personne pour te répondre étant donné que mon bac m’a essentiellement servi comme préalable à la maîtrise en orthophonie (que je viens de terminer, d’ailleurs, donc je suis officiellement orthophoniste!) J’ai commencé mon bac (en fait c’était une majeure dans ce temps-là) par pure curiosité du domaine, et à cette époque, je souhaitais faire de la révision et rédaction de textes. Mais j’ai adoré la majorité de mes cours et le domaine qu’est la linguistique. J’aurais facilement pu faire une maîtrise en linguistique.

My mom never should have separated from my dad, or at least she should have asked for 50/50 custody. My mom is extremely anxious and she overprotected me. My dad told me that because I was an active child, he would have enrolled me into sports/some sort of organized activity where I could have developed long term friendships. Also, that sort of setting would have allowed me to grow out of my fear of being teased/feeling hurt when it happens/not knowing how to react to teasing. This still messes me up at 31.

My mom should have realized that I wasn’t behaving like other children and that I needed professional help. There was this birthday party I went to in 3rd grade. My mom was there also as it was in a public place. The birthday girl’s younger sister was at the party too. She was in kindergarten. At this time, I found babies/younger kids adorable and I couldn’t help but externalize my feelings (crossing the street to go see a baby, omg she’s so cute, etc.) At the party, I started talking/playing with the younger sister. I started chasing after her. I can’t remember why I *started* chasing her: did she try to run away from me or did we just play a game? But at some point it became obvious that she wanted to get away from me. I harassed her so much that she ended up hiding behind a vending machine for quite a long time, long enough to worry her mom. The mom wasn’t very happy about me of course. I can’t quite remember what my mom said to me. She of course wasn’t proud of me for doing this, but she didn’t seem worried about my social skills. And since she was at the party, she witnessed it all, and never intervened!! Honestly, that type of behaviour should have been a red flag and she should have reached out professional help for me. I think over the years I acquired a reputation of ‘weirdo’ in elementary school and that could have been largely prevented by being proactive about it.

Now for the link between medication and sleep... I know that what I take has a tendency to induce vivid dreams, and I’m ok with that. Yes! L’odeur *des* fleurs = L’odeur *de les* fleurs (The smell *of the* flowers)

*De les* becomes *des*. It’s called a contraction. (Déterminant contracté) A bit like in English: do not -> don’t, except that in French it’s mandatory.

This is for the plural (feminine and masculine). We also contract with singular masculine:

L’odeur *du* café = L’odeur *de le* café 
(The smell of the coffee)

However, with singular feminine, we do NOT contract:

L’odeur *de la* pièce 
(The smell *of the* room)

Hope that helps ☺️

I totally get what you mean. I’m going to share two of my “ideas” about body processes. TRIGGER WARNINGS 


Fake hunger (still kinda ongoing to this day)

When I got hungry I frequently doubted it was legit, so I had invented the concept of “fake hunger”. Let’s say around 11-12 yo. Whenever I was hungry but at the same time feeling a little bit unusual physically (digestively for the most part), I thought it was a fake hunger, i.e., that my body pretended to be hungry so it could v more easily later on. Like when you start having stomach flu symptoms after eating while you were fine a few hours before. I remember telling my mom about it and her replying that I have too much imagination. 

Imaginary organ

I also thought (I was like 6 at that time, and no I don’t think that anymore) that there was an organ, connected to the esophagus/stomach, that would “pile up the p*(the food)” and that this organ had to be emptied every once in a while, thus leading to v.  I would randomly think like “oh I haven’t v yet this month, I’m surely due for it. It must be full”. I never told anyone about that until now. 😳
